# Paths the "Auto-Fix Formatting" workflow leaves out of every batch.
#
# One path per line, relative to the repository root, exactly as git prints it. Paths are literal: no
# globs. Lines starting with '#' and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Use it when a formatted file would break CI, or should not be reformatted at all (generated or vendored
# code). A batch that cannot be merged otherwise blocks every later one. Say why next to the entry.
